caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object, specifically a spur, set against a plain, light beige or off-white background. The spur is shown in a horizontal orientation, with the sole ring opening to the right and the rowel, which is a large black star-shaped wheel with multiple points, to the left. The main body of the spur is dark brown to black in color, with metallic highlights suggesting a worn, aged surface. At the right end of the object, three circular holes, likely for attachment, are visible, each containing a lighter metallic accent. The composition centers the spur in the image with empty space surrounding it, and a small printed label "R.W. TAYLOR" appears below and to the right of the spur, referencing the artist or creator.
title: Spur
